visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long reddish-brown hair is seated at a white desk in an indoor room with light-colored wood-paneled walls. She is wearing a grey knit top with a front knot and black shorts. She holds her smartphone and looks directly at the camera with a subtle smile and neutral eyes. (2) She points her phone towards the lens, revealing a photo of an infant on the screen. She begins gesturing with her hands, looking slightly off-camera as if speaking to someone behind the lens, while her facial expressions are animated and her eyes move expressively. (3) Colorful cartoon overlays appear on the screen, including a girl sitting at a table with pills and bottles. The woman moves her hands rhythmically to emphasize her speech, her facial expressions shifting between curiosity and humor while her background stays consistent. (4) Graphic illustrations of running figures and stylized sperm cells float near her as she continues her narrative. She uses wide hand movements to describe physical activities, while her background remains constant with a computer setup, monitor, and stationery. (5) A sequence of educational-style graphics appears, showing a person doing yoga-like leg raises and a stick figure assisting another in raising their legs. The woman maintains a lively presence, leaning forward slightly and using hand gestures to mirror the graphics. (6) The woman claps her hands and smiles broadly as heart icons and images of multiple infants in a womb appear on the screen. She ends the sequence by bringing her hands together in a prayer-like gesture, looking warmly at the camera.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 妳不是說... (2) [Subtitle]: 妳最近備孕一直失敗嗎？啊妳有在做什麼準備嗎？ (3) [Variety]: 葉酸. [Variety]: 肌醇. [Variety]: 排卵藥. [Subtitle]: 肯定都有！甚至連那種旁門左道的，我都全部試過... (4) [Slogan]: 助孕民間傳說#1. [Subtitle]: 像在❤️❤️之前，你們兩個要先各自去運動，大概20-30分鐘，讓血液加速流通，精卵子較快結合. (5) [Slogan]: 助孕民間傳說#2. [Subtitle]: 再來就是你那個結束之後啊，你也不能馬上去洗澡. 要倒立對不對？ (6) [Subtitle]: 對，如果你真的沒辦法的話，至少把腳抬高. 所以就會發生一個很好笑的場面就是，我跟我老公一結束的時候，他幫我把腳抬高. (7) [Variety]: 幫忙把腳抬高. 大家能想像那個畫面嗎😳？ (8) [Slogan]: 助孕民間傳說#3. [Subtitle]: 然後抬完腳之後呢，你也不能馬上去洗熱水. 溫涼的水沖洗. 否則會殺死精子+卵子. (9) [Slogan]: 助孕民間傳說#4. [Subtitle]: 當天禁止泡澡. (10) [Slogan]: 各位求子路上加油💪. [Subtitle]: 你知道博恩他有說，他的精子的活動力很弱，可是他還是受孕了. (11) [Subtitle]: 欸我跟你講，有趣的就是，其實我在之前有去檢查過，我老公是正常的，不正常的其實是我. (12) [Subtitle]: 為什麼要吃避孕藥？因為我月經很亂，避孕藥可以調經，第二個就是，保護自己嘛，因為男生就算有戴保險套，那也不是100%，所以我的子宮內膜比較薄，不容易著床. (13) [Subtitle]: 我在生完小布之後，我其實有把它養回來，現在是比較正常的厚度，只是我就是不知道為什麼，還是沒有辦法. [Variety]: 還是沒有辦法😔. (14) [Subtitle]: 什麼求子廟啊，我也都拜了啊，現在就是，先放棄吧，因為大家都跟我說，當你放棄的時候，他就自然會到了. [Variety]: 先放棄吧. (15) [Subtitle]: 緣分還沒到. 那妳下一胎會想要女生嗎？ (16) [Subtitle]: 其實我對於性別沒有要求，我反而是希望是異卵雙胞胎，因為我覺得超級酷之外，一次搞定. [Variety]: 預期生三個. [Variety]: 痛一次就好～/ 一次搞定. [Subtitle]: 希望求子成功 (努力中的大家一起加油❤️❤️).

It combines common myths with her own medical context, such as menstrual irregularity and thin uterine lining, to connect with viewers in a similar situation and offer encouragement through a lighthearted lens.
